csv_project_name: Design and Planning Services for Hoffman Estates Branch
csv_scope_of_work: The Schaumburg Township District Library ( Library ) is seeking qualifications from professional design and planning firms (or teams of firms) interested in helping us evaluate and plan for the future of our branch library locations. The primary focus of this project is the Hoffman Estates Branch and understanding whether the current site remains the right long-term location for continued investment and future library service delivery. The Library operates three locations: Central Library Schaumburg 130 S. Roselle Rd. Schaumburg, IL 60193 o Opened in 1998 o Approximately 166,000 square feet Hoffman Estates Branch 1550 Hassell Road, Hoffman Estates, IL 60169 o Built in 2002 o Approximately 9,700 square feet Hanover Park Branch 1266 Irving Park Road, Hanover Park, IL 60133 o Opened 2006 o Approximately 9,000 square feet
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Feasibility Studies, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Traffic Studies, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

title: Design and Planning Services for Hoffman Estates Branch
short_description: Planning study for the future location and development of a branch library.
project_location: Hoffman Estates Branch, 1550 Hassell Road, Hoffman Estates, Illinois 60169, USA
project_scope: The library seeks design and planning services to evaluate and plan the future of its branch library locations, with primary focus on the Hoffman Estates Branch. The key task is to assess whether the current Hoffman Estates site remains suitable for long-term investment and future library service delivery. Existing facilities include Central Library in Schaumburg with approximately 166,000 sq ft, Hoffman Estates Branch with approximately 9,700 sq ft, and Hanover Park Branch with approximately 9,000 sq ft.
services: Professional design and planning services; interior design and space planning; programming; rehabilitation and refurbishment; civil engineering; feasibility studies; land use planning; planning/master planning; traffic studies; urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a planning, feasibility, and master planning assignment rather than structural engineering.
- Focus is on library branch evaluation and site suitability, not on a defined complex building or special structure.
- Disciplines include civil engineering, but the notice is dominated by planning and studies.
- No indication of long-span structures, bridges, roofs, stadiums, or architecturally demanding structural systems.
- Project type aligns poorly with sbp's core focus and resembles feasibility/urban planning work, which is generally low priority.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The procurement is for evaluation, planning, feasibility, and potential future development decisions for an existing approximately 9,700 sq ft branch library; no defined construction measure or realistic construction cost estimate can be derived from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The notice is an RFQ/RFP for planning and evaluation services only, without a stated budget, fee schedule, or defined downstream construction scope.
references_qualifications: Professional design and planning firms or teams of firms are sought. Requested disciplines include interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, feasibility studies, land use planning, planning/master planning, traffic studies, and urban studies/planning/design. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Schaumburg Township District Library, Schaumburg, Illinois, USA. Contact: Annie Miskewitch. Email: mtilsch@stdl.org. Phone: 847-923-3202. Website: https://www.schaumburglibrary.org/bids/branch-needs-2026
notes: Target market is General Building. Pre-submittal meeting: 2026-07-01 09:00 AM CDT at Hoffman Estates Branch, 1550 Hassell Rd, Hoffman Estates, IL 60169; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 2026-07-08 05:00 PM CDT. The project is centered on strategic evaluation of branch library locations rather than a defined building design or structural intervention.
